text: Understanding databases is essential for managing data effectively. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store information in tables with rows and columns, making them ideal for structured data. NoSQL databases are more flexible and handle unstructured data well. To retrieve information, you use queries, which are commands that ask the database specific questions. Data modeling helps you plan how data is organized and connected before building anything. Indexes are another important feature—they work like a book's index, helping the database find information quickly instead of searching every row. Learning these basics will help you choose the right database for your project.
